cli.usage: Usage: mockgen help | mockgen info | mockgen generate --input <request.json>
cli.requestDocumentUnreadable: MockGen could not read the request document {{path}}: {{reason}}. Pass --input with a readable JSON file.

request.documentNotObject: MockGen request document must be a JSON object
request.unsupportedOption: MockGen {{path}} is not a supported generation option
request.signalNotAllowed: MockGen {{path}} cannot be supplied in a request document
request.unsafeTargetNames: MockGen project targets require unique safe resource names

options.seed: Mock data generator seed must be a safe integer
options.rowCounts: Mock data generator row counts must be integers between 0 and {{maximum}}
options.sftTimeout: Mock data generator SFT timeout must be an integer between 1 and {{maximum}} milliseconds
options.sftBudget: Mock data generator SFT budget must be an integer between 1 and {{maximum}} milliseconds
options.sftDeadline: Mock data generator SFT deadline must be an integer between 1 and {{maximum}} milliseconds
options.sftModelRows: Mock data generator SFT model rows must be an integer between 1 and {{maximum}}
options.sftPriorityTargets: Mock data generator SFT priority targets must be a list of entity set names
options.sftFieldsPerCall: Mock data generator SFT fields per call must be an integer between 1 and {{maximum}}
options.referenceDate: Mock data generator reference date must be an ISO 8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD)
options.windowYears: Mock data generator window years must be an integer between 1 and {{maximum}}

configuration.answerCacheDirectoryRelative: The MockGen answer cache directory must be an absolute path
configuration.resourceRootInvalid: The MockGen resource root must be an absolute path
configuration.resourceRootUnknown: The MockGen package cannot locate its resources directory, as in a CommonJS bundle. Copy the package's resources directory next to the bundle and pass its absolute path as resourceRoot.
configuration.domainResourcesDiffer: The MockGen {{resource}} below {{root}} differs from the one this process loaded from {{loadedRoot}}. A process uses one set of value banks, semantic rules and role registry: pass the same resourceRoot to every session, or a byte-identical copy.

integrity.resourceNotDeclared: The installed MockGen package does not declare its {{resource}}
integrity.resourceDigestMismatch: The loaded MockGen {{resource}} does not match the package manifest
integrity.manifestUnreadable: The MockGen model manifest cannot be read: {{reason}}
integrity.manifestInvalid: The MockGen model manifest is invalid: {{reason}}
integrity.manifestComponentsMissing: The packaged model manifest requires classifier and SFT components
integrity.datasetsCorrupt: The installed MockGen datasets are corrupt: {{datasets}}
integrity.modelArtifactsCorrupt: The installed MockGen package has missing or corrupt model artifacts: {{failures}}
integrity.modelArtifactsUnverifiable: The MockGen model artifacts cannot be verified: {{reason}}
integrity.classifierHeadMissing: The packaged classifier head is missing
integrity.classifierHeadInvalid: The packaged classifier head is invalid: {{reason}}

projectData.pathUnsafe: MockGen data directory must be a safe application-relative path
projectData.notRegularDirectory: MockGen data directory must be a regular directory
projectData.linksOrSpecialFiles: MockGen refuses a mockdata directory containing links or special files
projectData.unsafeParent: MockGen data directory contains an unsafe parent directory or link
projectData.escapesApplication: MockGen data directory escapes the application
projectData.resolvesOutside: MockGen data directory resolves outside the application
projectData.rejectedValidation: MockGen rejected project data with failed semantic validation
projectData.directoryChanged: MockGen project data directory changed during generation
projectData.changedDuringGeneration: MockGen project data changed during generation
projectData.changedBeforeReplacement: MockGen project data changed before replacement
projectData.rollbackFailed: MockGen rollback failed; originals are retained at {{backup}}

recovery.journalMissing: MockGen found an interrupted project transaction without a journal: {{transactionRoot}}. Its backup directory holds the original project data: if the data directory is missing or incomplete, move {{backup}} back in its place, then delete {{transactionRoot}} and retry.
recovery.journalUnreadable: MockGen project transaction requires manual recovery: {{transactionRoot}}. Its journal is unreadable; if it holds a backup directory, restore that as the data directory, then delete {{transactionRoot}}.
recovery.changedAfterInterruption: MockGen project data changed after interruption: {{directory}}
recovery.completedDataMissing: MockGen completed project data is missing: {{directory}}

lock.held: MockGen project data is locked by {{holder}}: {{lockPath}}. Waited {{timeoutMs}} ms. Wait for the other run to finish; if no MockGen run is active, delete the lock directory and retry.
lock.holderUnknown: a process that has not recorded itself yet
lock.releaseFailed: {{reason}}; the project lock could not be released
